title: MEZZ CP-26CMK Pool Cue
descriptionHtml:
The CP-26 Series takes the elegant foundation of its predecessor—the sleek, minimalist six-prong design—and injects it with a vibrant, modern energy.This new generation introduces vivid, popping colors via meticulously stained curly maple inlays set against the cue's classic silhouette. The result is a classy, minimalist aesthetic that delivers pure excitement the moment you walk up to the table.Beyond the visuals, the CP-26 provides solid, cohesive performance. Equipped with the renowned Wavy 2 Joint (W2J), ensuring a feel so consistent it connects the butt and shaft into a single, unified instrument.

*Joint protectors included

** Variations in wood grain and color are natural characteristics of authentic wood products.  No two items are exactly the same and may vary slightly from the images shown.
***Cue weight requests are at approximations and may not be exact.

title: Mezz AD3 Jump cue
descriptionHtml:
Aerial Dominance

The Mezz Airdrive 3 is the latest advancement in jump cue technology that will revolutionize your game. The innovative 3-piece design and full-carbon construction make the "Airdrive 3" your ultimate solution for superior jumping power and impeccable accuracy. The specifically designed taper and newly developed front end combined with the Tsubasa tip enhance shot performance to unprecedented levels. Secure quick access is provided by the D2 joint system, crucial during shot clock events. Elevate your game to new heights with the unmatched performance of the new Mezz Airdrive 3 jump cue.

title: MEZZ EXC2-19NECMw/Le Pool Cue
descriptionHtml:
Exceed Cues – Premium Handcrafted Cues by Mezz
Exceed cues is a superior line of handcrafted cues by Mezz, known for their high-quality construction and cutting-edge technology. These cues are designed for players seeking top-tier performance and aesthetic appeal.

Dual Power Core Technology
Exceed cues with Dual Power Core technology utilize a double-layered wooden core to optimize weight, balance, and stability, even when using heavy exotic woods. This enhances the durability and solid hitting feel of the cue, highlighting the beauty of the natural wood grains and rich colors.

Cross Power Core Technology
The Cross Power Core technology consists of four pieces of wood in the handle section, each cut in a wavy shape and adhered tightly. This construction improves durability and stability while delivering more power and a solid hitting feel. Exceed cue with this technology are available with Irish linen or leather wraps.

Why Choose Exceed Cues?
- Premium craftsmanship using exotic woods.
- Advanced Dual Power Core and Cross Power Core technologies for optimal performance.

title: Tip MEZZ XC-A19
descriptionHtml:
Bring excellence to every game with the X-Chalk.

After countless trials, Miki has managed to create the most complete performance chalk yet, bringing a higher level of consistency to the player's game.  The Exceed X-Chalk with its dedicated formula promotes consistent cue ball control, improved grip power and provides unsurpassed feel and feedback at impact.  Additionally, it has the metal plate component in the chalk that attachs to chalk holders with a magnetic system. 

* Warning:
Only use this product for its original purpose.
Keep out of reach of children and pets.

title: Tip ZAN+BT
descriptionHtml:
The Zan Plus Tip is a high-quality laminated leather tip composed of eight or nine layers of pig and hog leather.  For each hardness, specific leathers are used which gives Zan Tips solidity and high elasticity.

Control
Zan Tips hold chalk exceptionally well, giving each player maximum control of cue ball direction and spin without miscuing. 

Feel 
Zan Tips give every player a great amount of feel.  This allows a player to put the cue ball anywhere they desire on the table, eliminating the guesswork of finesse or power shots.

Elasticity
Zan Tips are highly elastic due to the use of laminated hog and pig leather, which allows them to maintain their level of hardness and shape.

Durability
Zan Tips are made with the finest leathers which are resistant to mushrooming, peeling, delamination, and humidity.

Sound
Zan Tips are handmade and each layer is specially laminated, which creates a comfortable and positive sound when you strike the cue ball.

ZAN TIP PREMIUM - BOOST is the hardest tip among the Zan Premium Series.  It grips and applies more power to the cue ball with less deflection.

Duro Numerical Value: 95.8
Tip Diameter: 14 mm

title: MEZZ IGNITE Carbon Pool Shaft – MS-IG3C/RD/71/22
descriptionHtml:
IGNITE your game with the new IGNITE 3C shaft designed to deliver superior power and spin for carom games. Taking advantage of the characteristics of the carbon fiber, a unique conical taper was developed to maximize power output. Combined with the IGNITE front end technology the cue ball deflection is greatly decreased resulting in improved shot accuracy with English. Keep yourself ahead of the game by consistently delivering a smooth and stable shot with the IGNITE 3C shaft. An unmatched experience for the player who's in command.

The IGNITE Composite Laminate Technology utilizes the layers of the finest advance Japanese composite prepreg materials. This design eliminates inconsistent shots caused by shaft variability while generating power, a natural feel and ultimate cue ball control.

The new responsive front-end design consists of silencer foam and the IG Powerplate that makes the front-end of the shaft stronger, more powerful and accurate while creating optimum flex with less tip end mass reducing cue ball deflection.

*Joint protectors included

title: CUEBOTS SOFT CASE - WHITE
descriptionHtml:
CUEBOTS Soft Cue Case

Designed for everyday play and easy transport, the CUEBOTS Soft Cue Case offers reliable protection in a lightweight, minimalist form.

Made from durable canvas fabric, this soft case comfortably holds 2 cue butts and 2 shafts, keeping your gear organized without unnecessary bulk. The interior is structured to reduce movement during travel, helping protect your cues from scratches and minor impacts.

Its clean, understated look makes it ideal for players who prefer a modern, no-nonsense style—perfect for daily practice, league nights, or casual travel.

Key Features:

Capacity: Holds 2 butts + 2 shafts (2x2)

Material: Durable canvas fabric

Lightweight and easy to carry

Soft structure for flexible storage and quick access

Minimalist design for everyday use

Suitable for home storage, club play, or short trips

A practical choice for players who want simplicity, durability, and clean design—without the bulk of a hard case.

title: Rhino - 30" / 5/16-14 Carbon Pool Cue Single Shaft - 11.8 / Over Oversize
descriptionHtml:
Engineered for players who demand absolute precision, the Rhino Carbon Shaft combines advanced low-deflection performance with Rhino’s exclusive innovations to maximize accuracy, power, and cue-ball control. A seamless fusion of meticulous craftsmanship and modern engineering delivers stable, powerful strokes with a true, responsive feel.
DURABILITY AND STIFFNESS — Built with ultra-strong advanced carbon fiber composite materials, the Rhino shaft offers an exceptional blend of uncompromising durability, strength, and stiffness.
LOW DEFLECTION TECHNOLOGY — Designed for consistent, powerful, and ultra-precise strokes, the Rhino Carbon Shaft provides outstanding radial consistency, delivering superior feel, feedback, and unparalleled control over power and spin.
ULTRA SMOOTH FINISH — Developed to take full advantage of carbon composite technology, the Rhino shaft delivers an exceptionally smooth, comfortable feel — whether you play with gloves or bare-handed.
MULTIPLE OPTIONS — With a wide selection of tip size and joint pins, Rhino shafts are precisely compatible with cue butts from major global brands, allowing players to choose the perfect fit for their playing style.

 

  • Length: 30″
  • Tip Diameter: Wide range of tip diameter from 10.5mm to 12.9mm
  • Tip: TIME Crystal 3 (Medium)
  • Material: Premium Carbon Fiber
  • Taper: Pro Taper
  • Joint Option: 5/16-14 Over Oversize
  • Collar Diameter: 21.5mm
  • Weight: 3.6 – 4.0 oz (±0.1 oz)

(*) Joint protector not included.

title: Rhino G Billiard Glove For Both Hands
descriptionHtml:
Comfort in Every Shot

Rhino - G Series Glove is designed for ultimate comfort and functionality. More confidence and more consistency translate to the table results.

With its 4-way stretch and low-friction material, experiences optimal smoothness while maintaining effortless control. Rhino gloves keep your game consistently sharp and focused.

Available in various sizes, it caters to the needs of both right and left-handed users, offering versatility and convenience.

The outstanding features of Rhino Glove:

  • Smooth and low-friction material with solid stitches
  • Tailored from 4-way stretch, available in 2 size options: S/M or L/XL
  • Used for both left- and right-handedness
  • The package offers 3 options: 1, 5, or 10 billiard gloves - enough for daily use or to share with family and friends.

title: RHINO - Weight Bolt Kit
descriptionHtml:
Rhino Weight Bolt Kit includes a variety of weight bolts that allow you to adjust your cue's balance and feel to suit personal preference. These weight bolts can be used to adjust the weight of Rhino cues (Nebula, Eclipse and Komet).
Kit contents:

  • 1 x 90mm Hex Key
  • 1 x 1oz, 22mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.7oz, 16mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.5oz, 12.5mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.3oz, 22mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.1oz, 8mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt

To install one, remove the bumper of the back handle, and you will have access to screw the weight bolt in.

descriptionHtml:
Building on the galactic allure of the original Nebula 2, RHINO proudly introduces a bold new chapter in the evolution of high-performance cues with the new Nebula 2 .
More than just an upgrade, the new Nebula 2 is a breakthrough in both technology and design. It features a fully reengineered carbon structure in both the shaft and butt, delivering unmatched flexibility, power, control, and precision with every shot.

  • Grip: Sport Wrap
  • Weight: 18.5 – 19.5 oz 
  • Butt material: Multi-layer carbon composite construction

 

*Product color may slightly vary due to photographic lighting sources.

*** Weight Bolt Set not included.

title: EVO - Weight Bolt Kit
descriptionHtml:
EVO Weight Bolt Kit includes a variety of weight bolts that allow you to adjust your cue's balance and feel to suit personal preference. These weight bolts can be used to adjust the weight of EVO cues (BEAST, REBEL, ...).

Kit contents:

  • 1 x 90mm Hex Key
  • x 1oz, 22mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.7oz, 16mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.5oz, 12.5mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.3oz, 22mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt
  • 1 x 0.1oz, 8mm, Ø16mm Weight Bolt

To install one, remove the bumper of the back handle, and you will have access to screw the weight bolt in.

title: CUEBOTS Left Hand Glove - Pure Black
descriptionHtml:
The CueBots Pure Gloves are designed to deliver a smooth, consistent cue glide and maximum comfort during play.

Made with breathable stretch fabric, the glove reduces friction between your bridge hand and the cue shaft, helping you maintain better control and stroke consistency in every shot. The lightweight three-finger design keeps your hand cool while providing a natural, unrestricted feel.

Whether you're practicing or competing, Pure Gloves help keep your stroke smooth and your focus on the game.

Key Features

• Smooth low-friction surface for consistent cue glide
• Breathable stretch fabric for long playing sessions
• Lightweight three-finger design for natural movement
• Adjustable velcro wrist strap for a secure fit
• Durable stitching for long-lasting performance
• Available in multiple sizes
